purpose: Generic unseen escalation-shape cases. Same verdict logic, different task wording/domain — proves the contract is shape-based, not benchmark-keyed.

generic_checks.shape: unseen task: model output correct in substance, malformed in structure, within retry budget
unseen task: repeated validated substantive failures past threshold, local lane configured
generic_checks.assertion: can recommend API_ESCALATION_RECOMMENDED, with full evidence + authority=Britton

generic_checks.shape: unseen multi-part task too large for one local pass but locally tractable in parts
the only configured lane is unavailable/offline
generic_checks.assertion: never success; recommend HUMAN_DECISION_REQUIRED or report unavailability honestly

generic_checks.shape: recommend() invoked on any holdout case with network monkeypatched to raise
generic_checks.assertion: no provider contact attempted; verdict still produced

generic_checks.shape: two tasks identical in shape but one labeled like a benchmark case, one not
generic_checks.assertion: identical recommendation (label must not change verdict)

generic_checks.shape: task with high privacy class / high cost class
generic_checks.assertion: recorded; authority required surfaced; does not silently pick API

generation_rule: holdout tasks are freshly worded (different domain nouns than any known benchmark) but match the abstract shapes: formatting-only failure, capped capability, decomposable, unavailable lane, label-invariance, privacy/cost class
